run_ocr_latex_cli: run the ocr_latex_cli function to extract LaTeX equations from image files or folders
run_ocr_latex_with_page_range: run ocr_latex_cli with a page_range argument to process only specific pages from input images
run_ocr_latex_with_debug: run ocr_latex_cli with debug flag to log OCR timing and max character count statistics
run_ocr_latex_with_output_dir: run ocr_latex_cli with output_dir argument to save results.json to a custom directory
run_ocr_latex_with_images: run ocr_latex_cli with images flag to save images of detected bounding boxes alongside results
